equity.level_reason: ACE prevalence is reported by race/ethnicity, income, education, employment, age and sex and framed as inequities with socioeconomic causes, but group values are only set side by side with no computed difference or ratio, so the cap at 2 applies.

level_alternative.reason: Groups are interpreted as inequities and specific determinants (discrimination, economic supports, policies) are named; if 'highest among' counts as quantified, level 4 follows.
